title: Score Popups
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about the numbers that rise when you score. A coin that is a monster pays 100 and becomes a blinking 100 that floats up and is gone; a gem and a box have numbers of their own, and one number never leaves. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and make your own.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie collects coins that are really monsters. Each one pays, then becomes a blinking number that floats up and goes. Play it, then open the game in Game-Maker and draw your own numbers.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A monster can become another when Kit touches it
Made to be copied and taken apart
